description: This file defines the AuthCodeEntity class which implements OAuth2 server's AuthCodeEntityInterface. It manages OAuth authorization code properties such as redirect URI, identifier, expiry time, user ID, client, and scopes, including methods for setting and retrieving these properties. It utilizes traits for date handling and OAuth server functionality.

classes.name: AuthCodeEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth authorization code with properties like redirect URI, expiry, client, scopes, and user info. Implements methods for managing and retrieving OAuth code details, with automatic expiry time handling.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the auth code.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the auth code.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the auth code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry DateTime of the auth code.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry DateTime of the auth code, overriding it to the current UTC time plus TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the auth code, if any.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Associates a user ID with the auth code.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with the auth code.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the client associated with the auth code.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the auth code.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Retrieves all scopes associated with the auth code.
